question: n India, which two years were known as annual plans before eighth five year plan was launched?
solution:
The correct answer is __**1990-1991, 1991-1992**__.
 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**
 
• The period of **1990-1991** and **1991-1992** were termed as **Annual Plans** in India due to the absence of a formally launched Five-Year Plan during this time. 
• The **Eighth Five-Year Plan**, scheduled for implementation in 1990, was delayed owing to political instability and economic challenges faced by the country during this period. 
• Instead of launching the Eighth Five-Year Plan, the government decided to implement **Annual Plans** for these two years to address immediate economic concerns and maintain continuity in planning. 
• During these Annual Plan years, the government focused on short-term strategies to stabilize the economy, which was under significant strain due to the **Balance of Payments crisis** and other macroeconomic challenges.
